name: acad-blocks
description: AutoCAD block (BlockTableRecord) authoring and instancing: define a block from existing entities, list / inspect / rename / purge block definitions, insert BlockReference instances with explicit attribute values, list and update attributes on existing references, explode references back to entities, and import block definitions across DWG files via WblockCloneObjects. All write operations require the AcadMcp .NET plugin loaded inside an open AutoCAD session and run inside a single transaction with a document lock.

tools_summary.name: bulk_insert
tools_summary.description: Insert many BlockReferences in one pass. For each item: if the block name is already defined it is reused; otherwise (autoImport=true) the plugin searches every registered library (or only libraryName if given) for a matching <blockName>.dwg and imports it as a new definition before inserting. Attributes / scale / rotation / layer per item.

tools_summary.name: define_block
tools_summary.description: Define a new BlockTableRecord (BTR) in the active drawing from a list of existing entity handles. The 'origin' point becomes the block's insertion (base) point. By default the source entities are erased after copying into the BTR.

tools_summary.name: define_block_from_file
tools_summary.description: Import an external .dwg file as a new block definition; the entire model space of the source DWG becomes the block.

tools_summary.name: delete_block_definition
tools_summary.description: Delete a block definition (BTR). Only succeeds if no BlockReference uses it. Use purge_unused_blocks to remove every unused block in one call.

tools_summary.name: explode_block_reference
tools_summary.description: Explode a BlockReference into its constituent entities in model space. Attributes are converted into DBText. Returns the list of newly created entity handles.

tools_summary.name: extract_block_references
tools_summary.description: Find every BlockReference (insert) of a given block definition (or all blocks if name is omitted). Returns each insert's position, scale, rotation, layer and attributes.

tools_summary.name: get_block_reference_attributes
tools_summary.description: Return all attribute reference (AttributeReference) tag/value pairs of a single BlockReference by handle.

tools_summary.name: insert_block
tools_summary.description: Insert a BlockReference of a defined block at the given position with optional non-uniform scale and rotation. Attributes are populated from the {tag: value} dictionary; missing tags fall back to defaults.

tools_summary.name: library_list
tools_summary.description: List every registered block library. When libraryName is given, only that library is returned and its .dwg file list is enumerated (when includeFiles=true, default).

tools_summary.name: library_register
tools_summary.description: Register a filesystem folder as a named block library. The path is scanned for .dwg files (recursively by default) and persisted to a user-scoped catalog so subsequent sessions remember it. Libraries are consumed by bulk_insert and swap_block (auto-import).

tools_summary.name: list_blocks
tools_summary.description: List every block definition in the drawing (excluding *Model_Space, *Paper_Space and other AutoCAD-internal records). Reports anonymous, dynamic and Xref flags.

tools_summary.name: purge_unused_blocks
tools_summary.description: Purge every block definition that has no BlockReference and is not an internal record (Model_Space, Paper_Space, anonymous *D / *E records). Returns the count removed.

tools_summary.name: redefine_block
tools_summary.description: Replace the geometry of an existing block definition with a new entity set; existing block references are updated automatically. Source entities are erased by default.

tools_summary.name: rename_block
tools_summary.description: Rename a block definition. Cannot rename Model_Space / Paper_Space, anonymous blocks (starting with '*') or Xrefs.

tools_summary.name: set_block_reference_attributes
tools_summary.description: Update one or more attribute reference text strings on an existing BlockReference. Tags not present in the BlockReference are silently skipped. Returns the number of attributes that were actually updated.

tools_summary.name: swap_block
tools_summary.description: Globally replace every BlockReference of oldName with newName, preserving position, rotation, scale and layer. When keepAttributes=true, compatible attribute tag/value pairs are copied onto the new BlockReference. If newName is not defined yet and autoImport=true, it is imported from the registered libraries first.
